t: San Diego council unanimously ratifies 45-day data center pause
b: The council backed the mayor's executive order halting data center permitting and development in city limits for 45 days, extendable for nearly two years. Staff have 180 days to recommend a framework, after a proposed 400-megawatt project at the NAVWAR site.
iw: Pause halts permitting; city may extend it and write new rules.
